With Sentry Mode on, only the USB-A port (where Sentry Mode saves its recordings) stays powered after you leave the car, so recording can continue. If the storage location is a drive on the Type-C port, that port loses power and recording switches to the drive on the USB-A port.

Writes to internal storage first, then moves each finished clip to the USB drive, reducing dropped frames on a slow drive. When on, recording doesn\'t switch to another USB drive if this one disconnects.

When over the cap or low on space, the oldest recordings are cleaned up automatically. Only unlocked files recorded by this app are deleted. Leave blank or enter 0 for no limit: nothing is deleted, and recording stops when space runs low.

resources.string: Repair changes these files directly: a rebuilt index is added to the end of each file, and the file name stays the same. Decoder settings and frame rate are taken from the latest healthy clip of the same camera, so the timeline may differ slightly from the original recording. Files that still can\'t be read after repair are restored automatically.
Repaired clips can be viewed in Videos.
Skipped: no healthy clip from the same camera to use as a reference
Skipped: couldn\'t read the decoder settings from the reference clip
The rebuilt index can\'t be read; the file was restored
The rebuilt index can\'t be read, and restoring failed

1. Put the iPhone and the car on the same Wi-Fi (the car's hotspot works).
2. On the iPhone, open Control Center and tap Screen Mirroring.
3. Choose “%1$s”.

To send just a video, tap the AirPlay button in the video's player and choose “%1$s”.
The iPhone screen opens in a floating window. Drag it to move, pinch to resize, push it to a side to dock it, double-tap for small or large, and tap × to stop.
The picture hides while the car is in gear or moving, unless the switch below is on. Apps with copy protection (Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV) show a black screen.
Move the card right until it is fully visible on the HUD. A test card shows each time you change it.
Can\'t connect? Open http://%1$s/info in Safari on the iPhone (the page may stay blank). The AirPlay log on the USB drive shows whether it reached the car.
For passengers. Watching video while you drive is dangerous and illegal in many places. When this is off, the picture hides while the car is in gear or moving.
Playing a video from the iPhone
Move the card\'s right edge in until long notices stay fully visible on the HUD. A test card shows each time you change it.
%1$d%% from the right. A long line shows where the card ends on the right side of the HUD.

On: apps like YouTube switch from mirroring to casting by themselves. The car downloads the video over its own internet, in better quality. Off: mirroring only. The iPhone streams the video, and the car just shows its screen and uses no internet.
AirPlay audio outside too. Hold for volume

Outside speaker on. It plays what you AirPlay to 7xDash: turn on AirPlay and play from your phone.
What you AirPlay to 7xDash also plays on the outside speaker, at its own volume. CarPlay, Spotify and radio cannot be copied: the car does not let apps capture them.
